recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless Clinical Genomics reintroduces a current-build sequence quality backbone that should be reviewed against the old INDEL/SNP/UNKNOWN quality type semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-11011 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Clinical Genomics change request asking to allow a type element under Sequence.quality. The resolution said to add Sequence.quality.type as a code with three choices: indel, snp, or unknown.
initial_application: Git commit 36543afd42c3489e5436c1c33a2a6988f7e36c31 explicitly referenced #11011 and changed source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml plus sequence-spreadsheet.sheet.txt to add Sequence.quality.type as a 1..1 code bound to qualityType with INDEL, SNP, and UNKNOWN codes.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini omits Sequence from the active [resources] list and lists Sequence under [removed-resources]. MolecularSequence is commented out in current build metadata, diagnostics guidance says MolecularSequence has been replaced by MolecularDefinition, and current MolecularDefinition source has no Sequence.quality-style quality backbone to update.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested historical change was already applied, and the original artifact is no longer an active current-build core resource definition.
